task8_changes: Adopted plans retain their original payload; reviewActive compares per-domain dependency versions and returns FRESH, STALE, UNKNOWN or EMPTY with source names and changed/unknown domains.

Live dependencies reuse effective body/profile/goal, corrected meal entries, canonical actual training and calendar, effective restrictions, symptom journal and pain feedback. SHA-256 tokens are local change detectors, not authorization receipts.
Old plans without dependencies and unreadable sources are UNKNOWN. Malformed current-athlete symptom journal cannot masquerade as empty and clear restrictions.
Preparation stamps dependencies. Confirmation rechecks them inside the existing Web Lock. Rejecting a proposal clears its token while preserving the adopted plan.
Nutrition-only edits do not invalidate an independent strength request; another athlete's meals do not affect the current athlete's proposal.

Goal conflicts from the existing effective profile require clarification. A new weight-gain goal cannot continue the prior fat-loss candidate; no new goal formula or silent goal mapping was introduced.

Personal panel subscribes to relevant store/events and athlete switches, renders stale/history plus conditional candidate, invalidates pending confirmation after dependent edits, and offers explicit rejection.

Existing nutrition facts retain corrected portions, known subtotal and unknown daily completeness. Activity calories versus total calories remain distinct in the existing tested energy-source chain; no new energy formula or automatic increase was added.
task6_changes: Cycle portrait retains measured performances separately from goal targets and adds explicit NOT_SEPARATELY_CONFIRMED running and strength experience.

Metric reference metadata reuses analysisReference: source/protocol/device, sample count, 30-day window and current/source refs. Single-day and no-reference evidence are descriptive, not an established personal baseline; different sources are segmented.
No new physiological threshold, medical conclusion, AI ability assessment, or learned personal adaptation formula.

public_contract.reviewActive: reviewActive(domain?: NUTRITION | STRENGTH | RUNNING | ALL) -> {status, changed, unknown, active, candidate, clarification?}; read-only, adopted active unchanged
public_contract.reviewProposal: reviewProposal(token) -> {status, changed, unknown}; a non-FRESH result invalidates the displayed confirmation
public_contract.reject: reject(token) -> void; clears only the matching proposal
public_contract.clarification: Goal conflicts return candidate=null and clarification; prepare/confirm reject until conditions are reconciled.
public_contract.dependency_scope: LIVE for browser collector; PROFILE_ONLY remains for standalone store consumers and is incompatible with LIVE freshness.
